summary: Fail-closed guard for the one edit to generated internal/mcp/bound/bound.go (const MaxBytes = 60000 -> var MaxBytes = Budget()).
reason: regen-merge classifies a const->var declaration change as TEMPLATED-CLEAN and --apply silently reverts it (mvanhorn/cli-printing-press#5418). This record lists only bound.go so the marker cannot be satisfied by a match in this record or in docs; ValidatePatchRecords then aborts the merge before the swap. Companion to mcp-canonical-bounding.json.
reapply: If regen-merge refuses with this record's marker absent: re-apply `var MaxBytes = Budget()` in place of `MaxBytes = 60000` in bound.go, per mcp-canonical-bounding.json reapply steps.
